issues.legal_issue: A contempt notice alleging delayed implementation of court directions may be discharged after the directions have been complied with and unqualified apologies have been tendered.
material_facts: The Court directed that an employee not be evicted from his government accommodation, be restored to it if already evicted, and be reinstated in service.
The employee was evicted and the directions were not implemented promptly; the responsible officer attributed the delay to communication delays, administrative bottlenecks, and security reasons.
The employee was later reinstated, given similar accommodation, and provided for the rent he had paid for private accommodation.

There was some material that might have shown the responsible officer knew of the order before the eviction, and an allegation that local officers resented the filing of the writ petition, but the Court declined to investigate these matters further in view of subsequent compliance and the apologies.
issues.conclusion: The Court accepted the respondents’ unqualified apologies and discharged the contempt notice. It also directed the responsible officer to pay the petitioners the costs of the proceedings.
issues.legal_principle: Court directions must be obeyed by everyone within the framework of the Rule of Law, including public officers, and failure to comply may warrant punishment. In this case, the Court did not pursue the alleged contempt further because there had been compliance and the respondents had tendered unqualified apologies. The judgment’s headnote identifies sections 2 and 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971; it relies on no earlier cases.

predicates.contempt_proceeding_alleges_disobedience: A party initiates a contempt proceeding alleging that a court direction was disobeyed.
predicates.court_direction_was_not_timely_implement: The persons responsible did not implement a court direction when required.
predicates.subsequent_compliance: The persons responsible later implemented the court direction.
predicates.respondents_tendered_unqualified_apologi: The respondents tendered apologies without qualification.
predicates.contempt_notice_discharged: The court discharges the contempt notice.

issues.definition: When a contempt proceeding alleges disobedience, the direction was not implemented promptly, compliance later occurs, and the respondents tender unqualified apologies, the contempt notice is discharged.
